responses.reason: The public specification does not state whether prev_in history from reset cycles should count. The current contract chooses that it does, allowing a 1 sampled while reset is high to pair with a 0 after release and set out. Record this ambiguity explicitly with both plausible interpretations.
responses.spec_quote: For each bit in a 32-bit vector, capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next. "Capture" means that the output will remain 1 until the register is reset (active high synchronous reset).

value.note: Whether prev_in should track in during reset cycles is unspecified; under the current contract, a 1 sampled while reset is high can pair with a 0 after release and set out.
candidates: prev_in tracks in on every posedge including reset cycles; a 1 sampled while reset is high followed by 0 after release captures (current behavior)
prev_in is cleared or ignored while reset is high, so reset-cycle history cannot cause capture after release
